title: steam condenser

sections.heading: Decision details
sections.text:
You see a steam condenser.
How to use: Carry it beside a natural steam vent with an empty single flask. Choose condense from the tool or vent's C menu.
Needs: empty carried flask; split a flask stack first.
Cost and limits: One action catches one water and spends one shared source catch, also used by scrapers and trays. Supply restores one catch per game day. Ash beds and ordinary heat give no water; frozen vents refuse.
Right now you can: condense 1 water into liquid flask (1 source catch, 1 action).

A clay-lined iron cap and a cooling neck. Catches one water in an empty flask from a steam vent, spending one of its shared source catches.
1 unit. Weight per unit: 2. Total weight: 2.
Lift Strength: 2; yours: 70.
You can carry this item.
Grip: one hand.
steam condenser cannot be thrown.
Pack weight: 23; with this item: 23. Burden threshold: 1050.
